extracted.name: Christmas Eve Beef Stew
extracted.description: This beef stew features potatoes, carrots, celery, and peas in a rosemary-tomato broth thickened with pearl tapioca. It can also be made in a slow cooker.
ingredient_lines: 2.5 pounds beef stew meat, diced into 1 inch pieces
1 (28 ounce) can stewed tomatoes, with juice
1 (10 ounce) package frozen green peas, thawed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees F (120 degrees C).
Place beef, tomatoes, celery, carrots, potatoes, onions, and tapioca into a Dutch oven. Season with beef bouillon, thyme, rosemary, and marjoram; stir in red wine. Cover with the lid.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5 to 6 hours. Add peas during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
